name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 4 visits over 21 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 23 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2025-06-03, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.17 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
